text:
alice_support: FYI customer on prod hit a spike of 500s after upgrading to redwood-python 1.31.0. They say requests are duplicated and incurring extra tokens.

ben_eng: Oof. Any error logs or minimal repro?

alice_support: Got a stack snippet from them: `HTTP 500 InternalServerError` and server logs show repeated identical request IDs. They also reported that passing `json_mode=True` used to work previously.

dan_customer: We upgraded from 1.30.7 to 1.31.0 yesterday. After that, our streaming calls sometimes fire twice. We're seeing double billing on some calls.

carla_sdk: Thanks - can you paste the client call you make? wondering if it's related to the new request dedupe changes.

dan_customer: Here's simplified call (sync):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., timeout=30)
resp = client.generate(model="rw-large", prompt="hi", json_mode=True)
print(resp.text)
```

carla_sdk: That `json_mode` flag was removed in 1.31 in favor of `output_format="json"` (doc change missed some spots). The compatibility shim should have been a noop but looks like in streaming path it triggered a retry branch.

ben_eng: Repro steps for us: locally we upgraded and ran a loop of 100 short requests with `json_mode=True` patched in. We saw ~1% duplicates — looks like the SDK transforms the param into an invalid header that causes a 429 from a downstream proxy and then retry logic replays the request without idempotency.

alice_support: Customer is asking for immediate mitigation. Any recommended pin?

evan_support: Recommend pin to 1.30.7 until we push a patch. Also ask them to remove `json_mode` usage as temporary workaround.

carla_sdk: Patch plan: revert the shim behavior in the streaming code path and add an explicit validation error instead of silently translating the param. Will cut a 1.31.1 ASAP.

ben_eng: Workaround snippet if they can't pin: set env var to force single-shot behavior `export REDWOOD_NO_RETRY_ON_429=1` — this will stop the client from automatically replaying on 429 but may surface transient errors. Use with caution.

dan_customer: Can you confirm pin command?

evan_support: `pip install redwood-python==1.30.7` — that matches what we tested.

alice_support: Customer also asked for billing remediation. Logging a ticket with billing; engineering to provide the dates and request-ids for reversal.

carla_sdk: If you can get us a few `x-request-id` values from their headers we can correlate server-side and mark duplicates for refund. Also we'll add a telemetry flag to detect when `json_mode` was present on 1.31.0 in their requests.

ben_eng: Root cause summary for support notes: accidental removal of defensive validation for deprecated `json_mode` lead to malformed request metadata on streaming path -> proxy returned 429 -> retry logic replayed non-idempotent request -> duplicate processing and billing. Patch will: 1) reinstate validation 2) ensure retries require idempotency token 3) add audit logs.

alice_support: ETA on 1.31.1?

carla_sdk: Working on it now. If nothing else blocks, aiming for a fast follow release in ~4 hours. Will post release thread when cut.

alice_support: Marking customer incident high priority and advising them to pin + opt into REDWOOD_NO_RETRY_ON_429 until patch. I'll collect request-ids for refund. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploybot: Rolling patch candidate to staging - run full e2e streaming suite.

ben_eng: Tests show fix prevents duplicates in our repro. Still running extended soak.

alice_support: Thanks team. I'll send customer the pin + env var workaround and update when 1.31.1 is out.

dan_customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround — keeping logs ready.

carla_sdk: Follow-up: once 1.31.1 is published we'll suggest they upgrade and remove REDWOOD_NO_RETRY_ON_429. We'll also provide the small migration note: replace `json_mode=True` with `output_format="json"` or drop param for default behavior.
